map.输入培训前后能力评分和参训情况，按柯氏前两层（反应/学习）评价培训效果: Enter pre- and post-training competency scores and participation details to evaluate training effectiveness with the first two Kirkpatrick levels (reaction and learning).
map.综合效果分 = (L1 + L2 + L3) ÷ 3，其中 L1 = min(1: Composite score = (L1 + L2 + L3) ÷ 3, where L1 = min(100, satisfaction × 10), L2 = min(100, test pass rate) and L3 = min(100, improvement rate × 2) (improvement rate = (post − pre) ÷ pre × 100%; when pre is 0 it is (post − pre) ÷ 10 × 100%). This page only measures the first two Kirkpatrick levels (L1 reaction and L2 learning: knowledge test + capability gain); L3 behavior and L4 results require post-training tracking and are not scored. Validation: participants and hours must be non-negative, scores must be 0-10 and the pass rate 0-100%, otherwise a prompt is shown. Grading: ≥85 excellent, ≥70 very good, ≥60 pass, otherwise needs improvement.
map.参训人数与时长须为非负数，能力/满意度评分须在 0–10 分、通过率须在 0–1: Participants and hours must be non-negative; competency/satisfaction scores must be 0-10 and the pass rate 0-100%

map.本页用柯氏前两层（反应/学习）打分合成培训效果分；行为层与结果层需训后 1–3: This page combines the first two Kirkpatrick levels (reaction and learning) into a training effectiveness score; behavior and results need 1-3 months of post-training tracking and a separate
map.年度培训规划排序，优先投入高杠杆主题。: Rank annual training plans and invest first in high-leverage topics.
map.满意度 9.0 → L1 = 90；知识测试通过率 92% → L2 = 92；: Satisfaction 9.0 → L1 = 90; knowledge test pass rate 92% → L2 = 92; average competency 6.0 → 8.0, improvement = 2.0/6.0 = 33.3% → L3 = min(100, 66.7) = 66.7; composite = (90 + 92 + 66.7) ÷ 3 = 82.9, grade "very good".
map.某课训后 3 月行为改变率仅 20%，低于目标 50%，建议改实操占比。: A course shows only a 20% behaviour change rate three months after training, below the 50% target, so increase the proportion of hands-on practice.
map.结合训后测评、上级评分与业务指标（如差错率下降）多源印证，单看满意度易虚高。: Combine post-training assessments, manager ratings and business metrics (such as a drop in error rate) across multiple sources; satisfaction scores alone tend to look inflated.

map.绩效差距、胜任力模型缺口与员工调研三方交汇处最该优先排课。: The intersection of performance gaps, competency model gaps and employee surveys should drive course prioritisation.
map.柯氏评估：本页测算 L1 反应（满意度）与 L2 学习（知识测试 + 能力提升）: Kirkpatrick: this page measures L1 reaction (satisfaction) and L2 learning (knowledge test + capability gain); L3 behavior and L4 results need post-training tracking and are not scored
map.反应/学习为前两层；行为/结果需训后跟踪: Reaction and learning are the first two levels; behavior and results need post-training tracking
map.能力提升率（本页 L2 技能）: Competency improvement rate (L2 skills on this page)
map.培训前后能力对比是最直观的效果指标: Pre- and post-training competency comparison is the most intuitive effectiveness metric
map.满意度调查应在培训结束后立即进行: The satisfaction survey should be run immediately after the session ends
map.行为层评估建议在培训后1-3个月进行跟踪: Behaviour-level assessment is recommended as a follow-up 1-3 months after training
map.结果层评估需结合KPI变化，周期较长: Results-level assessment must be combined with KPI changes and takes a longer cycle
map.培训效果评估工具，基于柯氏四级评估模型，从满意度、知识测试、能力提升三个维度评价: Training effectiveness assessment tool based on the Kirkpatrick four-level model, evaluating training effectiveness across satisfaction, knowledge testing and capability improvement.
